SYNTHETIC ENDOSCOPY REPORT
Date of service: 03/14/2031
Endoscopist: Corvin Ashdale, MD (fictional)

EGD: The gastroscope was advanced to the second portion of the duodenum.
Push enteroscopy: The enteroscope was then advanced to the proximal jejunum.
On withdrawal, a polypectomy of a 7 mm gastric body polyp was performed.
